error_locked: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
status_problem_hint: Add-on is running but not connected to {name}
offline_body: This messenger is not running or unreachable. Please check if the add-on is started.
notif_request_hint: Get browser notifications when new messages arrive.
notif_denied_hint: Please allow notifications in your browser settings.
status_warn_hint: {name} is connected, but the self-check reports changes on the provider side. Affected: {what}. Everything else keeps running.
status_health_ok: Connected – self-check clean ({n} internals, {s} response shapes checked)
share_empty: Type a text, drop files here or paste from the clipboard. On Android the portal also shows up in the share menu once installed as an app.
share_files_lost: The shared files could not be taken over. Open the portal once, then share them again.
share_file_too_big: {name} is larger than 64 MB and cannot be sent.
share_status_sub_whatsapp: Status for 24 hours – text, image or video
share_status_sub_telegram: Story for 24 hours – images only, for contacts
share_status_sub_signal: Story for 24 hours – image or video without text
share_status_need_media: A story needs an image or video.
share_status_images_only: Telegram stories only work with images here.
share_status_media_only: Only images and videos fit into a status.
share_status_no_text: Signal stories carry no text – clear the message or pick a chat.
mirror_hint: Also post new own WhatsApp status updates as a story. Text arrives as an image; images and videos need download_media in the WhatsApp add-on.
mirror_no_media: Image/video without file – enable download_media in the WhatsApp add-on
mirror_err: Sending failed – details in the portal log
mirror_wa_unreachable: WhatsApp not reachable – details in the portal log
sq_no_targets: No WhatsApp, Telegram or Signal add-on configured – there is nothing to post to.
sq_drop: Drag or paste images and videos here. From the phone: share → MessengerPortal → Status queue. Large photos and videos are shrunk automatically. Sort with ↑ ↓ – posting follows this order.
sq_err_rejected: rejected – details in the portal log
sq_no_caption_signal: Signal does not take a caption.
sq_need_target: Please tick at least one messenger.
sq_need_time: Please pick a date and time.
sq_past_time: That time is in the past.
share_queue_hint: Collected for later and posted from there – now or at a set time. Large files are shrunk.
